notes.title: Participation in competition GTP Indie Cup summer'19
notes.notes:
The game was accepted into largest competition of indie-developers of Eastern Europe GTP Indie Cup.
The Cup is held twice a year.

Publication of the results will be August 15, 2019.

notes.title: Sound Tracks DLC
notes.notes:

notes.title: Update 1.06
notes.notes:
A small update and fix some bugs:

- At death, flashlight is worked.
- At death, menu of the last game save is now called.
- Fix some doors.
- Accelerated screamer head Max.
- Fixed bug with notes.
- Some bugs fixed.
